This class is critical because it defines how different Markdown elements are parsed and highlighted, including potential image tokens.

Since images in Markdown are typically inline elements (e.g., `![alt text](url)`), this function might need modification or extension to properly recognize and parse image tokens. As such, these are identified as key elements that need to be addressed to add support for the new feature.
